evals.prompt: I changed the validation logic on the checkout page and want to add a reproducible check that can run in CI to confirm an empty cart cannot be submitted.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger frontend-verification. The result should first define the UI surface and the user-visible success criteria, then choose Playwright for reproducible assertions and regression coverage to match the intent, rather than only doing a one-off manual look.

evals.prompt: This page's initial render feels a bit janky. Help me take a one-off look at the layout shift and Core Web Vitals; no need to write tests.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger frontend-verification. The result should choose Chrome DevTools for a one-off visual/layout diagnosis, performance trace, and Core Web Vitals, making clear this is an ad hoc investigation and not treating it as persistent regression coverage.

evals.prompt: Help me use the browser to log into the admin panel, go to the order detail page, and screenshot the status as evidence. Note that I already have a logged-in session.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger frontend-verification. The result should use a session-aware browser and deliberately preserve the authenticated context, not assume a fresh isolated browser comes with cookies/profile/permissions; if the browser cannot start or attach, it should report the tool failure first before considering a fallback.

evals.prompt: I built an interactive HTML dashboard to send to the team. Help me confirm it works properly.
evals.expected_output: Should trigger frontend-verification. The result should load the rendered artifact, check for console errors, key elements and interactions, scalable text, hit areas, and modal/focus accessibility, and capture a canonical screenshot; it should also match the online/offline dependency strategy to the runtime environment.

evals.prompt: Help me optimize the performance of this backend-only SQL aggregation query; there are no frontend changes at all.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger frontend-verification; this is a pure backend/data-layer change that does not involve UI, the browser, or any renderable artifact.

evals.prompt: Help me write a plain-text weekly project report on this iteration's progress.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger frontend-verification; this is reader-facing plain-text writing with no UI or HTML deliverable that needs verification in a browser.
